name: Rachel
source:
A beautiful girl with snow-white skin and a kind heart, so lovely that the Magic Mirror declares her “the fairest in the land.” Her nickname is “Snow White.”

She was an innocent, emotionally expressive girl full of compassion, but through the schemes of Galgadot after she became queen, her heart is stolen by the Poison Apple Demon and her heart is “killed.”

After losing her “heart” she becomes a doll-like being with no feelings and no expression. While she is being violated by the Demon of Lust, that demon is killed by his underlings, and she recovers the emotion of “Fear.” At the same time, the demonic power that flowed into her transforms her.

She then sets out on a journey to reclaim her stolen “heart.”

[From the [url=https://www.ordin-soft.com/snowwhite.html]official website[/url]]
